Question: Let \(f(n) = n^3 - 5n^2 + 2n + 8,\) and let \(g(n) = n^3 - 6n^2 + 5n + 12.\) What is the sum of all integer values of \(n\) for which \(\dfrac{f(n)}{g(n)}\) is also an integer?
